modalLead: Container updates show their steps while they run, and Bookmarks gets a row height setting.

items.text: An update shows what it is doing: each container's steps are ticked off as they happen, with a short log of the download. One that fails stays open with the step that broke and why.
Updating a selection takes only the containers with an update, and says which ones it leaves out. The notice at the end names each one that failed and why.
A second update started right after the first no longer has its progress window closed under it.
Row height under Config → Bookmarks → View: Compact rows are as tall as the rows in Containers and Inbox, Comfortable gives each bookmark a little more room.
Config → Unraid explains what the widgets can do: how often they refresh, how many rows they show, a click to open Unraid, and alerts for the array, disks and parity.
